meaning: seems like; appears to be; similar to
usage: Used to express an impression or guess based on what you observe
Can mean ‘it seems like…’ or ‘it looks like…’
Also used to mean ‘similar to’ when comparing things
Very common in everyday spoken Cantonese

examples.jyutping: hou2 ci5 zau6 faai3 lok6 jyu5 laa3
examples.meaning: It seems like it’s about to rain.

examples.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 ci5 m4 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1
